title: Workflow finished
description: Starts the workflow when another workflow of the same workspace finishes. The input has workflowId, workflowName, executionId, status, errorCode, errorMessage, startedAt, finishedAt, durationMs and runUrl (when the web address is configured). Cancelled runs and runs started by this trigger never fire it.

workflowIds.title: Workflows
workflowIds.description: Workflows to watch (same workspace). Empty means every workflow of the workspace except this one.

events.title: Events
events.description: Which outcomes start this workflow: FAILED, SUCCEEDED or both.
